topic: Weekly recap: mempool, fees and difficulty
title: Weekly Recap: Mempool, Fees and Difficulty
hook: This week's recap: mempool, fees and difficulty in three points.

scenes.narration: Unconfirmed transactions wait in the mempool until a miner includes them.
Miners rank transactions by fee rate, because block space is scarce.
Difficulty adjusts every two thousand sixteen blocks, about two weeks.

cta: Which one was new to you? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Recap: mempool, fee rate and the 2,016-block difficulty adjustment.
